title: NTSC rational cadence wall (rd-duck B15 follow-up)

q5_abi_integer.effect: fabric treats NTSC as integer 24/30; 1:1 advance consumes ~1028 ppm fast

hard_wall.note: 20e6*1001/24000 is not integer — no integer line total hits 23.976024 exactly

claims_forbidden_until_fix: judder controlled for common NTSC rates
B15 framecount proves unique-bank lock under NTSC
claims_allowed: integer 24/25/30 class selection and short-window advance math

options_for_parent_abi.summary: Replace or extend content_fps with fps_milli uint16/24 (e.g. 23976, 29970)
options_for_parent_abi.pros: fits cadence floor(n*milli/display_milli); small wire change
options_for_parent_abi.cons: still approx; needs display_hz milli too for beam rate

options_for_parent_abi.summary: q6 or reclaim reserved: fps_num u16, fps_den u16 (24000/1001)
options_for_parent_abi.pros: exact rational matching host av_clock; ARM already has num/den
options_for_parent_abi.cons: ABI growth; fabric cadence needs 32x32 mul/div

options_for_parent_abi.summary: Keep integer class for V_TOTAL only; unique banks solely via ARM swap_pending at rational publish
options_for_parent_abi.pros: no fabric ABI churn; matches C1 (swap ignores advance)
options_for_parent_abi.cons: must never hold swap_pending=1 continuously; buffer policy is the lock

options_for_parent_abi.summary: Nudge V_TOTAL for closer Hz (still not exact at 20 MHz)
options_for_parent_abi.cons: cannot hit 24000/1001 exactly; residual ppm remains — NOT a full fix

recommendation: C short-term (honest) + B parent ABI for true fabric rational cadence. Do not ship NTSC source-lock claims on integer q5.
